# ucdpR

`ucdpR` is a toolkit for reproducible research with data from the
[Uppsala Conflict Data Program](https://ucdp.uu.se/). It provides a
consistent R interface for finding, downloading, importing, documenting,
and comparing UCDP datasets. Downloading data is the foundation, but the
package is designed to grow around the wider tasks that applied
researchers repeatedly encounter when working with UCDP data.

The package currently helps researchers:

- discover available datasets without hard-coding download URLs;
- download or directly import current and historical releases;
- pin exact versions for reproducible research;
- preserve source URLs, versions, retrieval details, and file checksums;
- retrieve official codebooks and dataset citation guidance;
- validate common identifiers, dates, fatality estimates, coordinates,
  and codes; and
- audit retrospective changes between two releases.

Because the catalog is read from the official download center at run
time, new UCDP releases generally do not require a package update.
`ucdpR` does not bundle or redistribute UCDP data.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("ucdpR") # after CRAN release
# pak::pak("christianoswald/ucdpR")
```

## Find and import data

``` r

library(ucdpR)

# See all current downloadable data files
catalog <- ucdp_catalog()

# Search without remembering exact titles
ucdp_search("georeferenced|candidate", catalog)

# Download a reproducible local copy
path <- ucdp_download("ged", format = "csv", dest_dir = "data-raw")

# Or download and import it directly
ged <- ucdp_get("ged", format = "csv")

# Inspect and download a frozen historical release
ucdp_versions("ged", format = "csv")
ged_24 <- ucdp_get("ged", version = "24.1", format = "csv")

# Monthly Candidate releases can be pinned in the same way
candidate <- ucdp_get("candidate", version = "25.0.12", format = "csv")

# Select a specific file when a dataset has multiple variants
brd <- ucdp_get("brd", variant = "dyadic", format = "csv")
```

For reproducible research, specify `version` explicitly and record the
returned filename, source metadata, and checksum. Imported objects
retain these details in their `ucdp_source` attribute. Cite the dataset
as requested by UCDP and avoid silently replacing frozen research data.
`ucdp_cite("ged")` retrieves the current citation guidance.

## Document provenance and retrieve codebooks

Objects imported with
[`ucdp_get()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/ucdpR/reference/ucdp_get.md)
retain their source record, exact version, retrieval time, checksum, and
the package version used. Summarize these details alongside basic data
coverage with:

``` r

ucdp_metadata(ged)

# Metadata can also be inspected before downloading a release
ucdp_metadata("ged", version = "24.1")
```

Download the official codebook listed with a dataset:

``` r

ucdp_codebook("ged", dest_dir = "documentation")
```

When several distinct documents match, refine the request with
`variant`. Historical requests return only codebooks explicitly
associated with the requested version and never silently substitute
current documentation.

## Validate imported data

[`ucdp_validate()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/ucdpR/reference/ucdp_validate.md)
performs transparent, non-destructive diagnostics:

``` r

validation <- ucdp_validate(ged)
validation$summary
validation$issues
```

The function checks plausible observation keys, date consistency,
fatality bounds, coordinate ranges, and selected UCDP categorical codes
when the relevant variables are present. Warnings flag values for
inspection rather than asserting that UCDP made a coding error. Use
`strict = TRUE` when warnings should also make the overall result
invalid.

## Compare releases

UCDP datasets can be retrospectively revised.
[`ucdp_compare_versions()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/ucdpR/reference/ucdp_compare_versions.md)
turns two official releases into a structured revision audit:

``` r

comparison <- ucdp_compare_versions(
  "ged",
  old_version = "24.1",
  new_version = "25.1"
)

comparison$overview   # added, removed, modified, and unchanged rows
comparison$variables  # number of revisions by variable
comparison$added      # complete newly added observations
comparison$removed    # complete removed observations
comparison$modified   # keys and variables changed in matched observations
```

For cell-level old and new values, set `detail = "cells"`. For large
releases where only counts are required, use `detail = "summary"` to
limit memory use.

## Package direction

Future convenience functions will build on the same principles:
reproducible inputs, explicit versions, transparent transformations, and
outputs that fit ordinary R workflows. The aim is to reduce recurring
data-management work for UCDP users while keeping analytical choices
visible and under the researcher’s control.

## Scope and attribution

This package is an independent community client. It is not affiliated
with or endorsed by UCDP or Uppsala University, and it does not
redistribute UCDP data. Data remain subject to UCDP’s documentation,
citation guidance, and terms.

# Package index

## Discover

- [`ucdp_catalog()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/ucdpR/reference/ucdp_catalog.md)
  : List files in the official UCDP download catalog
- [`ucdp_search()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/ucdpR/reference/ucdp_search.md)
  : Search the UCDP catalog
- [`ucdp_versions()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/ucdpR/reference/ucdp_versions.md)
  : List available releases of a UCDP dataset

## Download and import

- [`ucdp_download()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/ucdpR/reference/ucdp_download.md)
  : Download an official UCDP data file
- [`ucdp_get()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/ucdpR/reference/ucdp_get.md)
  : Download and import a UCDP dataset

## Reproducibility

- [`ucdp_metadata()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/ucdpR/reference/ucdp_metadata.md)
  : Summarize UCDP provenance and data coverage
- [`ucdp_codebook()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/ucdpR/reference/ucdp_codebook.md)
  : Download an official UCDP codebook
- [`ucdp_cite()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/ucdpR/reference/ucdp_cite.md)
  : Retrieve citation guidance for a UCDP dataset
- [`ucdp_update_available()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/ucdpR/reference/ucdp_update_available.md)
  : Check whether a downloaded UCDP file has a newer catalog version

## Work with UCDP data

Convenience functions for recurring research tasks.

- [`ucdp_validate()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/ucdpR/reference/ucdp_validate.md)
  : Validate a UCDP dataset
- [`ucdp_compare_versions()`](https://christianoswald.github.io/ucdpR/reference/ucdp_compare_versions.md)
  : Compare two releases of a UCDP dataset
